stem: Which sentence from the story contains descriptions that appeal most to the reader’s sense of touch?

options.label: F
options.text: This was the day he had waited for all year—the New Year’s Eve sand-sculpture contest at the beach.

options.label: G
options.text: Then he packed the sand with both hands while Max dumped on more sand and slapped it into a mound.

options.label: H
options.text: Rising out of the sand nearby were castles, dragons, whales, and mermaids.

options.label: J
options.text: A photographer hurried over to take a picture for the newspaper—two beautiful racing cars and four smiling sculptors.
